messages.content: 計算曲線y=3x^2 + 2x - 4在x = -1和x = 2之間的面積。

function.name: mathematics_calculate_area_under_curve
function.description: Calculate the area under the curve for a given polynomial function within a specified interval. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

polynomial.description: The coefficients of the polynomial, in decreasing order of exponent, where the first element is the coefficient for x^n, the second element is the coefficient for x^(n-1), and so on. The last element is the constant term.

limits.description: A list of two numbers specifying the lower and upper limit for the integration interval.

message.content:
**步驟說明** | 步驟 | 說明 | |------|------| | **1. 找根（決定正負區域）** | \(y=3x^{2}+2x-4\)。
\(\displaystyle 3x^{2}+2x-4=0 \Rightarrow x=\frac{-2\pm\sqrt{\,4+48\,}}{6} =\frac{-2\pm\sqrt{52}}{6}= \frac{-1\pm\sqrt{13}}{3}\)
兩個實根：\(x_{1}=\dfrac{\sqrt{13}-1}{3}\approx0.8685,\; x_{2}=\dfrac{-\sqrt{13}-1}{3}\approx-1.535\)。
於給定範圍 \([-1,2]\)，只有一個根位於內部，即 \(r=x_{1}\approx0.8685\)。因此函數在 \([-1,r]\) 為負，在 \([r,2]\) 為正。 | | **2. 求不定積分** | \[ \int (3x^{2}+2x-4)\,dx = x^{3}+x^{2}-4x+C . \] 設 \(F(x)=x^{3}+x^{2}-4x\)。 | **3. 計算有符號積分（檢查結果是否為零）** | \[ \begin{aligned} \text{Signed Area}&= \bigl[F(2)-F(-1)\bigr]\\[4pt] &=\Bigl[(8+4-8)-( -1+1+4 )\Bigr]=0 . \end{aligned} \] | **4. 分段求絕對值面積** | 面積＝\(|\!\!-\!\!(\int_{-1}^{r}(3x^{2}+2x-4)\,dx)|+ |\!\!+\!\!(\int_{r}^{2}(3x^{2}+2x-4)\,dx)|\\ \quad=&\;\bigl(F(-1)-F(r)\bigr)+\bigl(F(2)-F(r)\bigr)\\ =&\;F(-1)+F(2)-2F(r). \] | **5. 評估各項** | • \(F(-1)=(-1)^{3}+(-1)^{2}-4(-1)=4\)
• \(F(2)=8+4-8=4\)
• \(r=\dfrac{\sqrt{13}-1}{3}\approx0.868517\)
先算 \(F(r)=r^{3}+r^{2}-4r\)： \[ \begin{aligned} r &\approx 0.868517 ,\\ r^{2} &\approx 0.754326 ,\\ r^{3} &\approx 0.654794 ,\\ -4r &\approx -3.474067 , \end{aligned} \qquad F(r)\approx 0.654794+0.754326-3.474067\approx -2.064947 . \] | **6. 最終面積** | \[ \text{Area}=4+4-2(-2.064947)=8+4.129894\approx 12.13 . \] --- ### 結果 - 有符號積分（即「帶符號」下的面積）：**0** - 真正意義上的面積（取絕對值後累加）：**約 12.13 平方單位** 如果你想用程式自動化這一步，可以使用以下工具呼叫： ```json { "name": "mathmatics_calculate_area_under_curve", "arguments": { "polynomial": [3, 2, -4], "limits": [-1, 2] } } ``` 但請注意，該工具僅返回帶符號的積分；若需考慮絕對值，需要自行拆分區間並做上述手工或程式處理。

At x=-1: 3*1 + (-2)-4 = 3-2-4 = -3 <0. At x=2: 3*4 + 4 -4 =12+4-4=12>0. So it crosses somewhere between -1 and 2. We can find root(s). Solve 3x^2+2x-4=0 -> discriminant D=4+48=52 sqrt ~7.211.
